# Arcade Cabinet

Six games, playable in your browser, not inside Muse. 1. Stellar Defense : 11 by 5 formation that moves down and speeds up, 4 destructible shields, one shot at a time, points 30, 20, 10 by row, bonus saucer 150. 2. Asteroid Hunter : ship with drift, wrapping screen, splitting rocks, 20, 50, 100 points, risky hyperspace, bonus saucer 200. 3. Crossing : 5-lane road then river on logs and turtles, 5 homes to fill, 50 points plus time left per home, 500 points for all 5 homes, 60 seconds per frog. 4. Galactic Hunter : diving enemies, capture beam, recoverable double ship plus 500 points, bonus stage every 4 stages. 5. Maze Muncher : 240 pellets at 10 points, 4 power pellets at 50, ghost chain 200, 400, 800, 1600, cherry 100. 6. Maze Frenzy : different maze, moving fruit, strawberry 300, more random ghosts. Controls : keyboard and touch, touch buttons just below the game screen. Local scores only, per device and per site domain, no world leaderboard, no cloud saves, no multiplayer. Inspired games only : faithful mechanics, original names, visuals and sounds.
